selection: The same five R8-selected IDs, checked against their early C4 states; no C4 reselection
beta: sqrt(1-n_C4/n_critical), original wavelength, cold linear group-speed proxy; not measured wake speed
markers: Actual projected states, fixed colours, filled circles, no jitter, no energy or bucket membership cut
observations: Unfiltered histories where available; otherwise filtered diags. Missing does not establish loss.
optical: Measured m=1 E envelope, .25-2.5 k0 filter, factor .5 cycle average, .1 um smoothing; same as R8
interpretation: Instantaneous on-axis reference; no exact local or 3D trapping classification
identity_scope: Early state and native weight match, plus snapshot uniqueness and continuity; not a complete every-frame audit
